title: The Mortifying Ordeal of Being Seen
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High school seatmates Ikezawa and Eguchi trade increasingly sexually charged looks and comments in loosely connected comic scenes. Blunt, bookish Eguchi openly appraises cocky Ikezawa's body, and he, flustered, starts showing off for her. Originally self-published, it now runs on Shogakukan's Sunday Webry; Viz publishes it rated M.
life_message: Mutual attraction, spoken openly and without shame, is a source of fun and connection.

content.note: Steamy sexual flirtation between high schoolers; some exposed areas in bonus pages (ANN Manga Guide After Dark, Viz rated M); AniList Nudity tag; MangaUpdates Nudity.
Openly sexual comments to a classmate at school; reviewer notes others could be uncomfortable (ANN).
